g.text: → Alibaba / Tencent Cloud mainland: long-running gateway (Higress or your own) + Redis
avoid Function Compute / SCF; edge functions only in front
→ mainland entry + offshore node for overseas models
exit from a region OpenAI / Anthropic support (e.g. Singapore, Tokyo)
switch Alibaba Cloud offshore nodes to CDT by hand
→ Cloudflare Workers + one DO per key
billing split by month or an external database; logs without payloads
→ self-host on Oracle (first 10 TB of egress free each month)
already on AWS / GCP / Azure: egress bill similar to Chinese clouds
→ two entry points, each close to its users
billing in one place only, no dual writes
